source.name: Northwestern Mutual news release: Northwestern Mutual Becomes Official Financial Planning Partner of the Milwaukee Brewers
source.quote: announced today its expanded multi-year partnership with the Milwaukee Brewers, becoming the team's official financial planning and first-ever jersey patch partner
source.note: Continues in 2026: Blinkfire's 2026 MLB jersey patch list (https://analyticsblog.blinkfire.com/blog/2026/04/20/mlb-2026-jersey-patches-brands-buying-into-baseball) names 'Milwaukee Brewers - Northwestern Mutual Life'.
